summary: Tested the owner per-question Override (fix confirmed:true), the Fix-screen problem grouping, and the Forgot PIN live-paper guard. Everything ran in isolated disposable DBs (storage/AI mocked; no customer DB, no jeelive.ai, no AI, no re-reads). The production case was reproduced: Q3 has a lone continuation solution region ('ambiguous worked-solution start'), and Q2 has an unchecked solution region on solution page 3 ('Page 3, Q2: source region needs review'). A plain fix (confirmed:false) returns 200, but the rebuild adds the same issues back, so the loop is confirmed. With confirmed:true the soft issues are dropped and the mock goes held -> ready. Hard issues stay (missing key is kept even when the question is confirmed). A reviewer sending confirmed:true gets 403, and confirmed:false still works for reviewers. GET /problems now puts the solution-page issue on Q2's card (not under general) and returns 'confirmed' per question. For POST /api/auth/pin/reset: a live paper (deadline in the future or deadline 0) gives 409 with the right message. An expired deadline, an ended competition, a submitted attempt, a practice attempt (no competition_end) or another student's live paper do not block it (200). Signed-in POST /api/auth/pin is not blocked. New suite: 31/31 passed. Regressions: forgot_pin_iso184 53/53, typed_delete_iso185 54/54. UI was tested through a bridge on 127.0.0.1:8770. Owner on desktop 1920 and mobile 390: the solutions details and override checkbox are shown; answer, complete, override and Save gave a toast 3 times; after reload the page says 'Nothing is left to fix' with 0 cards. At 390px scrollWidth is 390 with no overflow, and the Save button is reachable below the override. Reviewer: 0 override checkboxes. /forgot-pin shows the 409 message in the error box on desktop and mobile.

minor.issue: question_problems() puts 'Page P, Qn' issues on a card when P is the next page after the question (pages[-1]+1). The confirmed filter in rebuild() only covers pages in source_regions (question/solution/key). If such an issue sits on the next page, the card shows it and the Override cannot clear it.

Matching uses only subject + printed number ('Physics Q3:' and 'Page P, Q3'). In a per_section mock where two sections of the same subject both have Q3 on shared pages, confirming one Q3 also hides the other Q3's soft issues.
limit_pin runs before the live-paper guard, so blocked (409) tries use up the 5-per-15-min reset limit. After the paper ends the student can get 429. This is acceptable, but could be reordered.

ui_bugs.issue: Solution images are fetched on mount even when the <details> is closed, so asset requests per card double. The backend 'asset' lane allows 8 in flight (runtime INFLIGHT_LIMITS). On the preview (React StrictMode) a 3-card mock already got 4x 503 capacity_busy and showed 'Original image unavailable. Reload to retry.' for question and solution pictures. A real chapter mock with 10+ held cards would hit this in production too, and the owner could not see the pictures they are meant to check before pressing Override.

issues: plain() turns both 'Page 3, Q2: source region needs review' (a SOLUTION-page issue) and 'Q3: ambiguous worked-solution start/continuations' into 'Check that the whole question is in the picture.' This is misleading: the problem is the solution picture, not the question.
The card header shows only the question pages ('Page 1') and the Full page buttons cover only question pages + next page. There is no button for the solution page (e.g. 309) where the issue is.

action_items: Render solution PrivateBookImage only when the held-q-<n>-solutions details is open (lazy). Optionally retry once with backoff on 503 capacity_busy, or raise/queue the asset lane, so owners can see pictures before Override.
Give solution-page issues and 'ambiguous worked-solution' their own plain() text (e.g. 'Check the solution picture on page P.'). Add a 'Full page P' button for the solution/key pages.
Optional: line up question_problems() 'near' pages with the rebuild confirmed filter (include pages[-1]+1, or drop it from problems), so every issue shown on a card can be cleared by Override.
Optional: also match section in the confirmed filter for per_section mocks.
critical_code_review_comments: book_publish.rebuild confirmed filter: the 'Page P, Qn' branch does not check HARD. None of the current Page-format issues are HARD, so this is fine today, but a future hard Page-level message would be cleared silently.

mock.confirmed is never cleared. If the owner later edits regions of a confirmed question, new soft warnings for it are hidden for good. Consider clearing a coverage key when its regions change in the page editor.
The UI shows the Override checkbox even when the only issues left are HARD. Ticking it saves fine but the card does not clear; a hint would help.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; image 503 under asset-lane limit)

seed_data_creation: None in the configured DB. Isolated DBs tejas_isolated_book170_* were created and dropped after each run; /tmp/uibridge/bridge.json removed.
test_credentials: Random owner/reviewer/student made inside the disposable DBs only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'cd /app/backend && timeout 280 python tests/override_guard_iso192.py' for the backend. For UI: 'python tests/override_bridge192.py 2400 &' serves 3 held mocks (f.desk/f.mob/f.rev = [bookId, mockId]) plus f.live_phone (a student with a live ranked attempt) on 127.0.0.1:8770. Cookies are in /tmp/uibridge/bridge.json; route **/api/** there in Playwright. The bridge pumps drain() every 1s so rebuilds run. Wait about 6s between card saves, because the card revision reloads after 4s.
rca of the issue: Production loop: fix_question() set answer/checked on the key/solution regions but never changed the solution region's continuation flag, and could miss a non-exact solution region. rebuild() then re-added the 'ambiguous worked-solution start' issue and the solution-page 'source region needs review' issue every time. The new owner confirmed list plus the rebuild filter breaks the loop, and this was verified in isolation.
